stem.text: Some antibiotics are used in animal feed to reduce disease.
What explains why these antibiotics should **not** be used in the treatment of human diseases?

A.text: Human cells may stop responding to these antibiotics.

B.text: Humans may be allergic to these antibiotics.

C.text: Pathogenic bacteria may develop resistance to these antibiotics.

D.text: Useful gut bacteria may be killed by these antibiotics.
